**Naming of the Surah**

• It was named "al-'Asr" (the Time) because it opens with Allah's oath by al-'Asr, which is time (ad-dahr) and the wonders it contains.

**Among the Aims of the Surah**

• To affirm and emphasize that man is in loss and ruin, except for the one who is characterized by what saves him: faith, righteous action, mutual counsel to the truth, and mutual counsel to patience. Included in this is an urging toward the deeds that bring about happiness, and an indication of the ruin of those who are heedless of them.

**[The Tafsir]**

Allah swears by time, because of the wonders of Allah's power it contains that point to His greatness, that the children of Adam are in ruin and deficiency. It is not permissible for a servant to swear except by Allah, for swearing by other than Allah is shirk (associating partners with Allah).
